// REQ: LANG-1801 LANG-1802 LANG-1803 LANG-1804
#include <sourcemod>
#pragma semicolon 1

/* Plugin info */
public Plugin myinfo = { name = "Greeter", author = "Jan", version = "1.0" };

public void OnPluginStart()
{
    RegConsoleCmd("sm_hello", Command_Hello);
}

public Action Command_Hello(int client, int args)
{
    char name[32];
    GetClientName(client, name, sizeof(name));
    PrintToChat(client, "Hello, %s! %d\n", name, 0x1F);
    return Plugin_Handled;
}
